items.quote: Brad repaired and painted the landing and stairs outside of my lanai that go down to the backyard. He is an excellent carpenter. He pays attention to the details and makes sure that the job is done correctly. He's a hard worker, reliable, and a pleasure to work with. I would not hesitate to hire him for other jobs.

Just had Renaissance Painting and Home Repair paint the exterior of my house and put in new floors in two bathrooms, couldn't be more pleased! Brad is super personable, always on time, keeps everything neat.

Brad, owner of Renaissance Painting and home repair gave us a free estimate for painting 3 areas of our house. The price was reasonable, so we hired them. Brad arrived on time, did an excellent job in the days alotted.
